name: List all consent groups
description: List all consent groups. Returns a paginated list of consent groups for the account. This endpoint is only available when the Consent Groups feature is enabled for your account. Returns `403` if the feature is not activated.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 50)

id.description: Unique identifier for the consent group

name.description: Display name of the consent group

description.description: Optional description of the consent group

signupMode.description: Controls how contacts are added to the group. `manual` — contacts are added explicitly via the API. `automatic` — contacts are added automatically at signup.
signupMode.title: ConsentGroupSignupMode

contactsCount.description: Number of contacts currently in this consent group

isDefault.description: Whether this is a system-created default consent group

createdAt.description: UTC date-time when the consent group was created (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)

updatedAt.description: UTC date-time when the consent group was last updated (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)

items.description: A consent group representing a category of contact opt-in/opt-out preferences.
items.title: ConsentGroup

consentGroups.description: List of consent groups matching the filter

total.description: Total number of consent groups matching the filter

execution.auth: API key in the api-key header, or OAuth 2.0. Not included here.

verification.notes: Generated from the public OpenAPI spec. A read-only call failed on the free account (HTTP 403); see errors.

plan_gated: Refused on the free plan: consent group is not enabled for this client

errors.when: Read-only test call on a free-plan account, with known test ids or no inputs

response.message: consent group is not enabled for this client

errors.agent_should: Likely a plan or permission restriction. Tell the user instead of retrying.
